comment: The MODE parameter has no ParamWidget and is set only from the menu. The gain chain is AUDIO_IN_GAIN 0.1 at :64, AUDIO_OUT_GAIN 10 at :65 and outLevel as the knob itself at :132, so full clockwise is unity and the default of 0.5 is 6dB below it. The 10Hz two-pole highpass filters are set at :265-270. The two polyphonic inputs are genuinely identical in function, so one line covers them and both tags point at it; the README calls them MULTI INS and describes one, but there are two, A and B, and they sum with each other and with the four separate jacks.
